Manage user-level drt settings (~/.drt/).

## Usage

```bash
drt config [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`set`](config-set.md) | Set a user-level setting. |
| [`show-telemetry`](config-show-telemetry.md) | Print the exact payload that would be sent for the next sync. |
| [`unset`](config-unset.md) | Remove a user-level setting (returns to default). |
